meta.name: price_lists
meta.description: Price lists (191, plan F-quote-package B2, jav/price_lists.py): how an uploaded price list (Excel or CSV) is read. columns: each column the price list needs, whether it must be there, and the headers it is known by, in Hungarian and English (document vocabulary: compared after lower-casing, with the spaces collapsed and a trailing colon or a bracketed note such as the currency left out). The header row is the first row within header_rows that names every required column. max_bytes, max_items: the limits of an upload. currency: the currencies offered on the settings page and the default one; vat_percent: the default VAT rate of a new list. The rules that change a price (a volume discount) are set on the settings page, not here and not in the file (DECISIONS 191); max_rules limits them.

changelog.note: 191 (plan F-quote-package B2): first version: the five columns (item code, name, unit, net unit price, category), the limits, HUF and 27% as the defaults.
